plugins.name: web-vitals-auditor
plugins.description: Run Lighthouse audits, diagnose Core Web Vitals regressions, and audit bundles, images, and fonts for performance wins.

skills.name: budget-generate
skills.description: Generate a performance-budget.json file for Lighthouse CI with reasonable defaults. Use this when the user asks to add performance budgets, set up Lighthouse CI budgets, enforce perf thresholds in CI, or create a budget config for their project.
headings: Generate a performance-budget.json for Lighthouse CI
skills.description_zh: 为Lighthouse CI生成带合理默认值的performance-budget.json，设置性能预算和CI阈值。

skills.name: bundle-analyze
skills.description: Analyze a Webpack, Vite, or Rollup build output for duplicated dependencies, unexpectedly large packages (lodash, moment, polyfills), and missing tree-shaking. Use this when the user asks to analyze a bundle, find what is bloating the bundle, check for duplicates, or reduce JS size.
headings: Example patterns. Run via Grep tool, not bash.
4. Legacy polyfills shipped to modern browsers
skills.description_zh: 分析Webpack、Vite或Rollup构建，识别重复依赖、异常大型包及缺失tree-shaking，帮助缩小JavaScript。

skills.name: font-audit
skills.description: Detect font-loading issues. Use this when the user asks to audit fonts, check for FOIT or FOUT, fix font-display issues, find synchronous font loads in CSS, or audit how many font weights are loaded. Scans CSS, HTML, JSX, TSX, and Vue files.
headings: Audit font loading for performance issues
skills.description_zh: 扫描CSS、HTML、JSX、TSX及Vue字体加载，识别FOIT/FOUT、font-display、同步加载及过多字重。

skills.name: image-audit
skills.description: Scan HTML, JSX, TSX, and Vue files for unoptimized images. Use this when the user asks to audit images, find images hurting LCP, check for missing lazy loading, find images without dimensions, or look for hero images that are not preloaded.
headings: Audit images in HTML, JSX, TSX, and Vue files
skills.description_zh: 扫描HTML、JSX、TSX及Vue的未优化图像，检查影响LCP、缺懒加载或尺寸以及未预加载hero图像。

skills.name: lighthouse-audit
skills.description: Run Lighthouse against a URL in both desktop and mobile form factors and summarize Core Web Vitals. Use this when the user asks to audit a page, check Web Vitals, measure page speed, or score a URL against Lighthouse. Parses the JSON output and reports LCP, CLS, INP, TBT, and TTI with pass, warn, and fail thresholds.
headings: Run a Lighthouse audit and summarize Core Web Vitals
skills.description_zh: 对URL分别运行桌面和移动Lighthouse，解析JSON并按通过、警告、失败阈值汇总LCP、CLS、INP、TBT及TTI。

skills.name: vitals-diagnose
skills.description: Interpret a Lighthouse JSON result and prioritize concrete fixes. Use this when the user has a Lighthouse report and wants to know what to fix first, or when a previous lighthouse-audit run produced warnings or failures. Maps each failed metric (LCP, CLS, INP, TBT, TTI) to its likely root causes and a specific remediation.
headings: Diagnose a Lighthouse result and prioritize fixes
skills.description_zh: 解释既有Lighthouse JSON，把失败的LCP、CLS、INP、TBT、TTI映射到可能根因及具体修复，确定优先级。

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the local performance-audit toolchain. Reports Node and npm version, whether Lighthouse can run, whether Chrome or Chromium is installed and reachable, and which bundler config is present in cwd. Use before running a Lighthouse audit to confirm the environment is ready.

commands.name: full-audit
commands.description: Run the full Web Vitals audit pass in one command. Chains doctor, lighthouse-audit, vitals-diagnose, bundle-analyze, image-audit, and font-audit into a single report against a URL and a local build. Use before shipping a release or landing a perf-related PR.
headings: Step 4: Bundle analyze (from `bundle-analyze`), if build dir exists

commands.name: serve-audit
commands.description: Serve a static build output on a local port, run Lighthouse against it for both desktop and mobile, then stop the server. Useful for auditing a production build without deploying anywhere.
headings: Serve a local build and audit it
Option 1: Install from the GitHub marketplace (recommended)
Option 2: Use a downloaded ZIP for one session
